Version 0.4.2 focuses on reliable navigation, reliable filters and native-bound
form controls. Existing behavior remains the default. This guide describes the
0.4.2 development candidate; check `packageVersion("glasstabs")` before using
new arguments on a CRAN installation.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(glasstabs)
```

## Modern workspaces

![Workspace tabs with drag handles](https://prigasg.github.io/glasstabs/reference/figures/tabs-draggable.png)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
glassTabsUI("workspace",
  glassTabPanel("edit", "Edit", shiny::textInput("title", "Title")),
  glassTabPanel("preview", "Preview", shiny::p("Preview"), closable = TRUE),
  style = "segmented", indicator = "solid", transition = "none",
  reorderable = TRUE, persist_order = "session", touch_reorder = TRUE,
  equal_width = TRUE, glass_strength = 0.25, theme = "auto")
```

Desktop, keyboard and touch handles share the reorder controller. `-tab_order`
reports the order; `-close_request` asks the server to remove a tab. See the
[tabs guide](tabs.html) for storage precedence and closure authorization.

## Select dimensions and surfaces

```{r, eval=FALSE}
glassSelect("month", month.abb, width = "130px", size = "sm",
            glass_strength = 0.25, theme = "auto")
glassMultiSelect("region", c("North", "South"), width = "100%",
                 dropdown_max_height = "18rem", size = "sm")
```

The original 160px width remains the default. Narrow fields respect their
parent. Panels respond to visible
viewport changes and use a scrolling fallback in very tight space.

## Native-bound form controls

![Switch, radio, and checkbox controls](https://prigasg.github.io/glasstabs/reference/figures/form-inputs.png)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
glassSwitch("enabled", "Enable filters", TRUE)
glassRadioGroup("mode", "Mode", c("Edit", "Preview"))
glassCheckboxGroup("columns", "Columns", c("Name", "County"))
```

Use ordinary Shiny server input values and update functions. See the
[component gallery](component-gallery.html) for examples and the
[cheatsheet](cheatsheet.html) for a compact reference.

## Reliability improvements

Dropdowns respect modal focus boundaries, dismiss when their pane goes
inactive, and scroll options without moving the page. Nested widgets own
their shape and theme. Appended panes load dependencies and bind before their
links are committed. Failed/cancelled appends clean up their pending operation.

## Try the candidate

```{r, eval=FALSE}
runGlassExample("modernization")
runGlassExample("final-features")
```

Review the [changelog](../news/index.html), [troubleshooting](troubleshooting.html)
and [deployment guide](posit-connect.html) before shipping. Physical mobile
verification and third-party widget integration remain release checks.
